body: I'll later test it with logcat and see if I can catch any errors.

It works when output path is set to `Documents` directory.  I suspect this might be due to Android filesystem restrictions, something to do with `content URI`.
Previously I had only tested with Documents directory so it might not be a regression? removing regression label for now.

It was a single line change, but tracking down the issue took some effort.
